type: Send a welcome email to knj@company.com and schedule an onboarding meeting

plan.stepName: Create email account for new employee
plan.stepDescription: Use create_email_account with employee_name='KnJ', employee_email='knj@company.com', department='Onboarding'
Use send_email with to='knj@company.com', subject='Welcome to the Company!', body='Dear KnJ, we are excited to have you onboard. Looking forward to working with you.'
Use create_calendar_event to schedule a meeting with KnJ for onboarding, including date, time, and agenda details.
